Engineer turned designer, exploring the intersection of design and logic. Focuses on 0–1 product design, design systems, tactile interface craft, and visual design for startups.

## Selected Projects & Design Case Studies

### 1. Nepali Tales: Designing a Pre-Order System
- Route: /work/nepali-tales
- Client: Nepali Tales (Cloud kitchen based in Thane, Maharashtra; Founders: Ashika & Dipesh)
- Role: Lead Product Design, UX/UI Design, Product Strategy
- Platform: Responsive website, web admin panel
- Scope: Designed a 0–1 digital pre-order platform transitioning ordering from manual WhatsApp messaging into an automated time-slot ordering system.
- Confirmed Project Metrics:
  - 14.3K+ unique visitors
  - 34.5K+ page views
  - 770 payment transactions
- Live Platform: https://www.nepalitales.com/

### 2. Plix: From Brief to Brand Expression
- Route: /work/plixlife
- Brand: PlixLife (D2C plant-based wellness and nutrition brand, part of Marico)
- Role: Visual Design Intern
- Scope & Deliverables:
  - Cross-collaborated with Brand Team and Packaging Team
  - Designed campaign assets and marketing communications across digital channels
  - Produced visual assets for product categories (nutrition, effervescents, skincare, haircare)
  - Created packaging collateral and contributed to UI/UX refinements
